summary: LEIFRAS Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of its business transfer (acquisition) of Well Resources Co., Ltd.'s child development support and after-school day care service business. The transaction, governed by a Feb 27, 2026 agreement, was consummated on May 1, 2026 for an all-cash consideration (undisclosed amount). LEIFRAS acquires four facilities in Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal mechanics beyond cash payment are disclosed. The filing confirms execution of a previously announced asset purchase; no regulatory clock or risk-arb angle as terms are settled.
